payload.detail: Lifeline WA boosted in PR #3157; national crisis lines remain unpinned for generic youth queries. Owner ruling 18 Oct 2026 00:10 AWST: do NOT add national youth crisis lines to the CAMHS-specific pin list yet. This ruling does not prohibit the existing Lifeline WA pin supplied by the separate adult_metro_crisis intent when an acute youth query also matches that adult-crisis intent; any CAMHS pinning must await owner approval of the exact list, exclude services that are closed, planned, superseded or marked temporarily unavailable, and keep CAMHS Crisis Connect and MHERL first. PR #3617 dropped its unapproved pinning attempt and cancelled its done request.
